name: gy-corporate-income-tax
description: Guyana corporation tax for the 2026 year of income (year of assessment 2027) under the Corporation Tax Act, Cap. 81:03, as amended by the Fiscal Enactments (Amendment) Act 2026 (Act No. 3 of 2026). Covers resident and non-resident companies, the 25% rate for non-commercial companies, 40% for commercial companies, 45% for telephone companies, the dual rate for companies with both activities, the 25% small business rate, the 2% minimum tax on the turnover of commercial companies and its carry-forward, the new 2026 exemptions for agriculture and agro-processing and for child care and elderly care, close company director fee limits, loss relief limited to half the tax, 10% withholding on payments to non-resident contractors, 20% withholding on dividends and payments to non-residents, advance tax on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December, the 30 April 2027 return (G0003) and penalties. Trigger on: Guyana corporation tax 2026, commercial company 40%, non-commercial 25%, minimum corp
